notes: Controlled vocabulary for tagging CANlab publications. Tags are assigned from the full text where a PDF is available, otherwise from the abstract. 'topic' and 'approach' are multi-valued; 'type' is single-valued. Chip colour = axis colour.

values.label: Placebo effects
values.def: Placebo or nocebo effects, treatment-expectation effects on symptoms or brain responses, open-label placebo, conditioning-based placebo analgesia, or the mechanisms of the treatment context.

values.label: Pain
values.def: Pain perception, nociception, analgesia, experimental pain in healthy people, or pain neuroscience.

values.label: Chronic pain
values.def: Clinical pain populations or chronic pain (back pain, fibromyalgia, headache, pain trajectories, pain treatment trials).

values.label: Emotion
values.def: Affect, emotional experience, valence, negative affect, fear, anxiety, disgust, or the neural representation of emotion categories.

values.label: Emotion regulation
values.def: Cognitive reappraisal, self-regulation of pain or emotion, mindfulness or attention-based regulation, or top-down control of affect.

values.label: Empathy & social affect
values.def: Empathy, vicarious pain, compassion, prosocial behaviour, social rejection or social pain.

values.label: Stress
values.def: Psychological or social stress, threat, cortisol and HPA axis, stress physiology, or stress-related health effects.

values.label: Expectation & learning
values.def: Expectations, beliefs, predictive cues, conditioning, reinforcement learning, or predictive-coding accounts of perception.

values.label: Social influence
values.def: Social cues and social context, interpersonal communication, patient-provider interaction, social information about others' ratings, or cultural factors.

values.label: Reward & craving
values.def: Reward, valuation, pleasure, food or drug craving, addiction, or decision making about value.

values.label: Cognitive control & memory
values.def: Executive function, working memory, attention, inhibition, task switching, interference resolution, or long-term memory.

values.label: Brain-body interactions
values.def: Autonomic physiology, interoception, immune or inflammatory measures, brainstem and hypothalamus, cardiovascular reactivity, or metabolism.

values.label: Clinical & psychopathology
values.def: Psychiatric or neurological populations (depression, anxiety, PTSD, dementia, bipolar disorder), clinical outcomes, or treatment trials other than pain-specific ones.

values.label: Perception & consciousness
values.def: Sensory perception (touch, vision, taste, audition), somatosensory topography, awareness, or consciousness.

values.label: fMRI
values.def: Functional MRI data are collected or analysed (task fMRI, resting state, 7T fMRI).

values.label: Neuroimaging methods
values.def: The paper develops, evaluates or teaches analysis methods for neuroimaging: statistics, preprocessing, reliability, power, software, tutorials, or best practices.

values.label: Neuromarker / brain signature
values.def: Develops or tests a predictive brain signature or biomarker (e.g. NPS, SIIPS, PINES, VIFS), or evaluates a neuromarker's validity, generalisation, or clinical use.

values.label: Machine learning
values.def: Multivariate pattern analysis or predictive modelling with cross-validation (SVM, LASSO, PCR, PLS, decoding, classification, representational similarity).

values.label: AI integration
values.def: Uses deep neural networks, convolutional networks, large language models, generative or foundation models, either as analysis tools or as models compared against brain data. Tag when found anywhere in the methods, even if not in the abstract.

values.label: Computational model
values.def: Formal or mathematical models of behaviour or brain function (reinforcement learning, Bayesian inference, drift diffusion, dynamical systems, simulations).

values.label: Mediation
values.def: Mediation or path analysis, including multilevel mediation, mediation brain search (M3), or moderated mediation.

values.label: Meta-analysis
values.def: Quantitative synthesis of published results, including coordinate-based neuroimaging meta-analysis (MKDA, ALE) and effect-size meta-analysis.

values.label: Mega-analysis
values.def: Pooled analysis of individual-participant data from multiple independent studies or datasets (multi-study, consortium, or large biobank data).

values.label: Genetics & heritability
values.def: Twin or family designs, GWAS or polygenic scores, gene expression, or other genetic and heritability analyses.

values.label: Pharmacology
values.def: Drug manipulations or drug mechanisms (opioids, naloxone, remifentanil, cannabinoids, ketamine, SSRIs, analgesics).

values.label: Psychophysiology & EEG
values.def: Skin conductance, heart rate, EMG, pupillometry, EEG, ERP, MEG, or intracranial recordings.

values.label: Brain stimulation
values.def: TMS, tDCS, temporal interference stimulation, deep brain stimulation, or other neuromodulation.

values.label: PET / structural / spinal imaging
values.def: PET, structural MRI (gray matter, VBM, cortical thickness), diffusion imaging, spinal cord imaging, or other non-fMRI imaging.

values.label: Behavioural & self-report
values.def: Behavioural experiments, ratings, questionnaires, surveys, or clinical assessments without neuroimaging as the primary measure.

values.label: Open data & tools
values.def: Releases a dataset, software, toolbox, atlas, or paradigm, or is about data sharing and open science.

values.label: Empirical
values.def: Reports new data or new analyses of existing data (experiments, trials, secondary analyses, meta- and mega-analyses).

values.label: Review
values.def: Narrative or theoretical review, perspective or synthesis of a literature.

values.label: Methods / tools
values.def: Primarily describes an analysis method, software, tutorial, atlas or resource.

values.label: Book chapter
values.def: A chapter in an edited book or handbook.

values.label: Commentary
values.def: Comment, editorial, letter, reply, news feature or short opinion piece.
